execution.note: Source arithmetic was reproduced from saved builder outputs and the selected B observer receipt. No raw-data pass, literature review, regression, model solve, target change, or weight change was performed.

selected_case.source_validation_boundary: Selected B is a diagnostic selected point, not an adopted or converged calibration. The stored target rows are auditable; economic equivalence to the model observer is assessed separately below.

empirical_source_validation.sample: National PSID reference persons (RELTOHEAD_=10), positive IW, finite NETWORTHR, ages 18-85; EARNINDRRC finite and nonnegative for working-age records; waves 2003 and 2005.
empirical_source_validation.aggregation: Ratio of weighted aggregate sums; not a mean of household-level wealth/earnings ratios. The builder bootstraps reference-person IDs (999 replications, seed 20260723).
empirical_source_validation.geography_and_weights: National PSID with positive family/reference-person IW; no geography subsample or fixed effects. Model is aggregated over all locations. Survey weights and population masses are conceptually parallel, but survey sample composition is not otherwise matched.
empirical_source_validation.validation_limit: Reproduced from saved component outputs and the pinned contract, not by rereading raw PSID microdata.

selected_B_model_observer.formula: sum g_asset*(b + owner*p*H) over living ages 18-85 / sum working-cell mass*[four-year after-payroll-tax labor-income flow / 4 / (1-tau_pay)] over ages 18-65
selected_B_model_observer.age_coverage: Selected observer uses all 17 four-year cells labeled 18 through 82 for the wealth stock and the 12 working cells (18-65) for earnings; this agrees with the empirical age ranges at the cell-interval level.
selected_B_model_observer.flow_units: Empirical EARNINDRRC is annual gross earnings. Model P.income is a four-year after-payroll-tax flow; observer divides by four and grosses up by 1/(1-tau_pay), so the stored ratio has annual units.
selected_B_model_observer.accounting_timing: Beginning-period wealth from the pre-transaction balance-sheet distribution; the observer annualizes earnings once.

selected_B_model_observer.formula: annualized expected nonnegative post-saving estate flow divided by beginning-period aggregate liquid/net financial wealth plus owner gross housing value; annualizes model-period flow exactly once
selected_B_model_observer.timing_and_mortality: Saved observer uses the current/death distribution and post-saving estate policy; pre-terminal death probabilities follow survival, while terminal death probability is forced to one.
selected_B_model_observer.housing_and_debt: Model denominator uses the same b+owner*pH total-wealth construction as wealth_earnings. The external target has no source-level component/mortgage treatment here to establish equivalence.

empirical_source_validation.sample: Living national PSID reference persons, relation_to_head=10, positive IW, ages 76-84, finite completed-child count observed, INCFAMR>1000; waves 2003 and 2005.
empirical_source_validation.aggregation: Quantiles are taken over household NETWORTHR/INCFAMR ratios, then p90 is divided by p50; this is not a ratio of aggregate means. The weighted-quantile convention is the smallest ordered value reaching the requested cumulative positive weight. Bootstrap resamples reference-person IDs (499 replications, seed 20260715).
empirical_source_validation.geography_and_weights: National PSID; positive IW and person-ID clustering. No geography restrictions or fixed effects.
empirical_source_validation.validation_limit: Reproduced from saved builder output and pinned definitions, not a new raw-data pass.

selected_B_model_observer.age_rule: Uniform within-cell overlap for ages 76-84: one-half of label-74 cell (ages 74-77), all of label-78 cell (78-81), and three-quarters of label-82 cell (82-85). This is an explicit projection approximation, not exact annual-age model states.
selected_B_model_observer.income_rule: Model annual gross income helper yields pension income at retirement under this case (retirement z scale and property-tax transfer are zero); four-year flow is annualized. PSID INCFAMR is annual family income with broader components.
selected_B_model_observer.model_sample: Living model mass in the age-overlap cells with positive pension-proxy income. The observer does not impose the PSID INCFAMR>1000 cutoff or observed completed-child-history filter.
selected_B_model_observer.quantile_rule: Same weighted quantile algorithm as the empirical builder; model value is a quantile ratio, not a ratio of means.

legacy_stationary_crosscheck.reason_visible_in_source: The legacy solver selects four-year labels by their start age (labels 78 and 82); the scored early observer applies explicit uniform within-cell 76-84 overlap weights. They are distinct saved observers, not duplicate reproductions.
legacy_stationary_crosscheck.implication: The target_fit value is faithfully reproduced from the named early observer, but a model-code-path discrepancy remains material and should be reconciled before production activation.

linked_entry_wealth_note.source_basis: Inherited checkpoint-P wealth marginal; historical source ratios are young childless-renter NETWORTH2R/INCFAMR quintile-bin means. This differs from wealth_earnings, whose denominator is RP/spouse gross labor earnings.
linked_entry_wealth_note.model_conversion: wealth = empirical ratio * four-year after-payroll-tax P.income * old entrant z / (4*(1-tau_pay)); the converted nodes are rank-coupled to the new persistent income rank, with iid income independent conditional on persistent rank.
